# Casper node, sidecar and command-line client

> Operator and integrator references for the Casper node software: casper-client at v5.0.1 (the release CasperAI's commands are pinned to); casper-node at its latest release (v2.2.2) with its release notes since 2.0 - the only published account of the 2.1 and 2.2 protocol changes - and its changelogs; the casper-node-launcher that delivers protocol upgrades; the casper-sidecar JSON-RPC, SSE and REST server; the binary port protocol; and the Casper 2.0.0 upgrade notes.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from casper-ecosystem/casper-client-rs@10329ed, casper-network/casper-node releases, casper-network/casper-node-launcher@bbcf072, casper-network/casper-node@bbb2890, casper-network/casper-protocol-release@cc06edd, casper-network/casper-sidecar@62c9522.
